description: Measures the DC offset of a signal — the average voltage it carries above or below zero

inputs.text: The signal whose average is measured

outputs.text: The average of the input over roughly a second, clamped to ±10V

notes: the lamp is green while the average is within 0.05V of zero, red while the average is positive and blue while it is negative.
a polyphonic input is measured channel by channel but every measurement is written to the first output channel, so only the last channel's average reaches the output and the rest read 0V.
